groups.saying_opens: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يرتفق

notes: two sayings: the curtain (Aisha's act) and the cushion report, each with its own names; the second is the speech of «رجل ... ربيعة بن عطاء» in the session, so its route starts at him, not at the first route's head
«أبا محمد» is a bare kunya written as it stands; the gloss «- يعني القاسم -» is not used
